pre_evaluation_amendment: Before dev/test execution, reuse one actually executed same-prompt encoder for both best-of-2 decoder candidates and provide pinned acquisition/dependency/exclusion entrypoints. No evaluation outcome motivates this amendment.
amendment_rule: Record and refreeze pre-evaluation engineering amendments. Do not change the protocol based on final-test outcomes; a substantive amendment after accessing those outcomes requires a new protocol ID and a new independent evaluation cohort.

cohort.prior_roster_registry_role: historical provenance path; reproduction uses the bundled wrapper without requiring this earlier checkout path
cohort.historical_exclusions_wrapper_scope: same prior 384 image IDs and fingerprints; wrapper bytes, path and manifest hash differ from the earlier run
cohort.reference_access: train references may supervise Cell fitting and terminal training outcomes; actors receive observations only; reference integrity checks may read every split

execution.checkpoint_interpretation: capacity, not an enforced traversal count; a trace stopping after 2 or 3 decisions contributes only those actual decisions
execution.budget_overrun: record actual duration; invalidate quality and coverage; do not truncate measured cost to the cap

cells.interpretation: four sparse decoder-logit residual adapters, not four modality generators

exploration.used_trajectories: record actual nonempty trajectories and every action count; retain failed episode receipts

ndu.local_matrix: token-probability-weighted covariance of the four current Cell logit residuals, with zero residual outside their vocabulary
ndu.coverage_scope: finite random behavior trajectories; no global optimality or unseen-state coverage guarantee

baselines.name: base
baselines.mechanism: fixed frozen base, greedy tokens, no Cell control

baselines.name: static_cells
baselines.mechanism: uniform four-Cell weights and prefix geometry constraints

baselines.name: best_of_n
baselines.mechanism: one actual same-prompt encoder execution shared by at most two independent decoder generations under the same total cap; first greedy, second temperature 0.7 sampling; train-fitted quality verifier selects

baselines.name: mean_only
baselines.mechanism: quality-only offline actor-critic; inference risk weight forced to zero

baselines.name: risk_actor_critic
baselines.mechanism: TD and return-anchored action values plus fixed-threshold risk heads; no BSDE residual

baselines.name: ndu
baselines.mechanism: discrete BSDE quality/loss critics, bounded sampled action allocation and optional local-matrix penalty

ablations.name: ablate_fixed_weights
ablations.mechanism: uniform weights throughout; same policy behavior as static_cells under the same constraints

ablations.name: ablate_missing_modality
ablations.mechanism: replace visual input with a same-size black image; retain category and execute encoder

ablations.name: ablate_shuffled_pair
ablations.mechanism: use next image in the same split with the original category; score and render against the original source

calibration.method: pooled positive Platt scale and offset; source-correlated outputs remain 32 independent source groups

evaluation.box_matching: maximum-cardinality one-to-one bipartite matching at IoU>=0.5
evaluation.valid_output: completed generation, valid normalized boxes, valid PNG artifact, complete measured cost receipt and actual duration within the cap
evaluation.largest_side_correct: largest predicted bbox center is on the same left/right side as the largest reference bbox
evaluation.label_correct: normalized emitted label equals target category; emitted label is supplied by the task adapter
evaluation.text_consistent: parsed count, label and side equal those derived from emitted boxes; explanation is deterministic
evaluation.severe: invalid/incomplete/over-budget OR incorrect count/side/label/text consistency OR box_F1<0.5
evaluation.CVaR_estimator: mean of the worst n*(1-alpha) losses using fractional boundary mass; for n=64 use six largest losses plus 0.4 of the seventh, divided by 6.4
evaluation.coverage: fraction of valid outputs; failures remain in the denominator and have quality zero
evaluation.calibration_diagnostic: test Brier score of the separately calibrated verifier severe probability
evaluation.artifact_check: PNG digest, decodability and original dimensions; no independent overlay-geometry or pixel-generation score
evaluation.frontier: descriptive nondominated quality-up, CVaR-down, measured-wall-time-down, coverage-up points at the same cap

paired_bootstrap.comparisons: NDU versus each of six other baselines

cost.scope: warm resident-worker episode wall time, measured with exclusive components
cost.failed_work: retained as measured failed-attempt time; unavailable internal token/call counts explicitly marked
cost.encoder_reuse: one real encoder execution per episode; same-prompt best-of-2 candidates reuse that encoded state; no cross-arm or cross-task encoder reuse
cost.extra_sampling: each candidate independently executes and charges its decoder, sampling and verification; the episode charges the shared encoder exactly once
cost.communication: in-process controller; no distributed Cell communication cost is claimed

future_scientific_gates: 8-to-16 actual decisions per suitably long task, with measured causal contribution
independently learned natural-language and pixel outputs with crossmodal semantic evaluation
calibrated terminal-output loss covariance from independent outcomes
quality-risk comparison at matched actual compute cost and coverage
new independent confirmatory cohorts and broader decoding seeds
complete state/noise representation and continuous FBSDE or Merton control theory
